title: File Explorer — Tree + CRUD + Preview + Properties
description: A complete, backend-agnostic file explorer: a directory tree sidebar, breadcrumb navigation with history, grid and list views, full CRUD (new folder, rename, move, copy, delete/Trash), drag-and-drop upload and move (files AND folders, structure preserved), an inline preview lightbox (image / audio / video / pdf / text), file download, a Properties editor (edit the text body plus metadata: a custom icon glyph, an endpoint URL, and arbitrary key/values), a right-click context menu, multi-select (cmd/shift), and keyboard shortcuts. Storage is pluggable via an injectable FileExplorerAdapter (host fs / S3 / Convex / your own); the bundled in-memory mock is a real filesystem with bytes, so preview, upload, download, and editing all work with zero backend.

previews.seed: in-memory mock adapter (seeded tree); rename / new-folder / move persist for the mount
